name: Standing IT Band Stretch
steps: Stand tall near a wall for light balance if needed and cross one leg behind your other leg with both feet grounded.
Raise the arm on your back-leg side overhead and keep both hips facing squarely forward.
Press your hips gently sideways toward the back-leg side while leaning your torso softly in the opposite direction.
Hold steadily when you feel a clear stretch along your outer hip and thigh, then stand tall and switch sides.
tips: Keep your chest facing forward rather than twisting your shoulders down toward the floor.
Keep your rear knee straight and lean gently without forcing your lower back sideways.
